entries.title: Zn doping reveals robust two-gap superconductivity in FeSe
entries.summary: Researchers using the Steady High Magnetic Field Facility have found that zinc doping unexpectedly alters the superconducting properties of iron selenide (FeSe) while preserving its two-gap superconducting state.

entries.title: Unified framework establishes rules for classifying unconventional magnets
entries.summary: Researchers from the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science (HFIPS) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) have developed a unified framework for establishing symmetry criteria and classifying unconventional magnets.
